title: Ami Shapir Na’eh
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He speaks in Rabbi Yochanan’s name: [Gittin 41a](https://www.sefaria.org/Gittin.41a.8-9). (Hyman reports that [Rashi](https://www.sefaria.org/Rashi_on_Gittin.41a.8.2) explains that this was his epithet. See also the entry Ami of Vardina.)[^1]

notes.text: The linked Gittin names Ami speaking in Rabbi Yochanan’s name and follows it with wordplay on his epithet. The linked Rashi glosses Shapir Na’eh as his nickname.
